adobe_api.scope: Photato-only frame operations; no dedicated operation in pinned published Adobe contract. Existing Adobe Smart Object operations remain bounded as documented. Editable PSD frame transport remains unsupported and explicitly rejected.

limitations: Full Photoshop/live/physical-platform/pixel equivalence remains unqualified; desktop last observed locked, no re-probe or bypass. Native controller/model tests are not live interactions.

Editable PSD/PSB frame descriptors, linked external image placement, drag-and-drop replacement and generative Fill within Frames are not implemented. Save editable frame documents in native28; rendered exports retain appearance.

Canvas gestures preview outlines then commit the image result. Rich selection handles, contextual tasks, all Photoshop preferences and exact frame/content thumbnail layouts remain open. Frame Properties changes outline dimensions without automatically refitting content; Fit is explicit.
Text frames use native TextKit/CoreText outlines; glyphs without outlines reject. Font fallback, complex scripts, vertical/warped/path typography and exact Adobe glyph positions are unqualified.

Frame from Layers preserves original editable children, following the Rust grouping workflow. Drawing around a selected image embeds it first; Place replaces all descendants with one retained Smart Object. Fit requires one image child.

Frames use physical canvas coordinates, delta affine transforms and existing canvas/resource limits. Strokes use document-pixel width after transform. Photoshop stroke scaling and additional rotated/nonuniform contexts need independent qualification.
